meta.purpose: Corrections recorded since 5 November 2026, so a reader can see what changed and why. The list says nothing about errors that have not been found or recorded. The Fino connector's corrections() tool returns this list unchanged.
meta.status: 175 corrections are recorded. The list shows only the errors Fino found or was told about, so a page that is not on it is not proven correct: write to hello@finoprivacy.com and quote the decision number.
